# Zenn

> > Zenn is a Japanese tech knowledge-sharing platform for engineers, featuring articles, books, and publications with monetization support.

Zenn serves as a community hub where engineers publish technical content, tutorials, and books on topics including AWS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, AI development, and various development tools. The platform supports both free articles and paid technical books, with features like Publications for team content and community guidelines for AI-assisted writing.

## Key Topics

- Zenn platform features and Publications
- AWS (re:Invent, EC2, S3, Bedrock)
- JavaScript/TypeScript development
- React and Next.js
- AI tools (Claude, OpenAI, Cursor IDE)
- Vue.js and VoidZero toolchain
- Chrome extension development
- WSL and Linux development environments
- Code refactoring (jscodeshift)
- Angular framework
- Shopify app development
- Doxygen and gnuplot
- Game development (Godot)
- Community guidelines and best practices
- Technical book publishing

- [Zenn|エンジニアのための情報共有コミュニティ](https://zenn.dev): Homepage: Tech knowledge sharing platform for engineers with monetization

- [Zenn公式さんの記事一覧 | Zenn](https://zenn.dev/zenn): Official Zenn account with platform updates and usage guides
- [コミュニティガイドライン | Zenn](https://zenn.dev/guideline): Community guidelines covering content policy, AI usage, and conduct
- [ZennのPublicationで投稿を続けたら、社内のエンジニアと技術書を出版することになりました](https://zenn.dev/ncdc/articles/30423095420e06): Case study: Publishing AWS Amplify Gen2 book via Zenn Publication

## Development Environment Setup

- [初心者のためのCursor AIエディター完全ガイド](https://zenn.dev/ai4u_shunsuke/books/cursor-ide-guide): Complete beginner's guide to Cursor AI editor setup and usage
- [WSL開発環境: 環境構築の記事まとめ](https://zenn.dev/atsushifx/articles/wsl2-debian-setup-matome): WSL Debian development environment setup guide and article index
- [【入門者向け】Chrome拡張開発の第一歩：デベロッパーアカウント作成ガイド](https://zenn.dev/murasame_works/articles/d6c5da26d1ba3a): Beginner guide: Chrome extension developer account setup tutorial
- [gnuplotのインストールと実行方法あれこれ](https://zenn.dev/leviosa42/articles/aaa76e147f533f): gnuplot installation guide for Windows/Linux with execution methods
- [Linux環境でDoxygenの出力形式にCHMフォーマットを使う方法](https://zenn.dev/aikige/articles/generate-chm-from-doxygen-on-linux): Generate CHM format from Doxygen on Linux using chmcmd and Free Pascal
